profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a full-stack web developer, I’ve brought countless ideas to life over the years building everything from production-ready systems to quick-turn proof-of-concept projects. I’m largely language-agnostic, though JavaScript will always have my heart.

I thrive in collaborative environments, believing that a team’s victories (and missteps) are best shared equally. Right now, I’m focused on consulting and crafting prototypes that turn “what if” into “here it is.”

When I’m not coding, you’ll likely find me in the air flying, tuning, and racing FPV drones or in the shop, woodworking, tinkering, and chasing down whatever creative rabbit hole catches my interest next.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
- Building and maintaining a custom header bidding solution using Prebid.
- Maintaining a customer facing revenue dashboard allowing clients to follow their financial
goals in real time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Number 1 on the Inc. 5000 list (2019) and have remained on the list three years in a row.
- Building and maintaining a frontend header/footer bidding Web SDK (JavaScript) for 600+ publisher sites.
- Improve level of confidence in Web SDK code base by adding unit (Mocha/Chai) and end-to-end (Cypress) testing.
- Improve bundling and publishing of Web SDK, including optimization and a raised level of developer experience.
- Building and maintaining a dashboard single page application (Vue.JS) for reporting.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building dynamic websites focused for the legal space.
- As a tech lead, provide guidance and paths for growth to more junior developers.
- Lead projects from handoff of design partners to completion of launch.
- Collaborate with design partners in order to mitigate discrepancies found in the design in an effort to maintain consistency and positive UI/UX principles.
- Help raise the level of DX (Developer Experience) in the company as a whole.
- Introduce more modern processes and tooling to better streamline our pipeline.
- Help convert legacy Perl code to Node.js in our backend and full React on the frontend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed, processed, and optimized large datasets to support advertising operations across multiple brands and platforms.

Developed and maintained interactive dashboards to present campaign performance, audience insights, and revenue metrics in visually engaging formats for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define KPIs, standardize reporting processes, and improve data accuracy.

Utilized data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, D3.js, and custom-built solutions) to provide actionable insights that drove strategic advertising decisions.

Streamlined data pipelines to reduce reporting time and increase accessibility for decision-makers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Using latest modern web development tools, create web sites with custom CMS solutions for new and existing clients. Build "digital brochure" apps for iOS natively in xCode. Focused the growing and expansion of learning with junior developers in the company. Integrated protocols for better communication throughout the company, more efficient production workflows and collaboration for developers.

positions.title: Software/Web Developer
positions.description: Produced numerous lead generation frontends while working closely with a small team of frontend developers and backend engineers building technology that verifies and tracks highly qualified leads for data sales and call transfers, as well as assisted in the maintaining of the internal API frontend and any mySQL database schema changes.
